$comment: Each attestor is a Schema.org Person (https://schema.org/Person). Documented at https://fossfoundation.info/crosswalk#attestors
title: Crosswalk Attestors Schema
description: People whose human-attested crosswalk evidence counts as confirmed. Adding someone is itself a reviewed pull request.

sameAs.title: Same as
sameAs.description: Profile URLs that identify the person, such as GitHub, ORCID or Wikidata.

roleName.title: Role
roleName.description: Optional. The attestor's own role at the organization in memberOf, for example Board Member or VP Infrastructure. Leave both out when the attestor is not associated with one organization.

memberOf.title: Organization
memberOf.description: Optional. The organization the attestor is associated with: the identifier of a _foundations or _entities record, or, for an organization not listed on this site, the URL of its website.

keyFingerprint.title: Signing key fingerprint
keyFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the OpenPGP or SSH key the attestor signs commits with, if any.
